reconstruction_quality: Codec-only JPEG Q25/Q50/Q75/Q90 and learned methods use measured PSNR/SSIM. RAW is exact and is annotated rather than assigned a finite PSNR bar.
channel_usage: Only transmitted methods with measured complex channel uses are included; log scale is used.
channel_resource_saving: Computed from measured complex channel uses as 100*(1-method/RAW+LDPC).
supplementary_metrics: LPIPS and CLIP remain in final_comparison.csv/json and are not main plots.
